parent_objective: localize bounded-panel outcome dominance from existing M1777 artifacts
blocked_by: M1778 blocks ranking until outcome dominance is localized
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from global M1777 success rate

public_gates: M1779 must use only M1777 artifacts and must not rerun reset or rollout
M1779 must localize outcome dominance by role panel profile metric family hidden dynamics road timing lateral and sampled label
M1779 must write summary and slice tables that identify ranking blockers
M1779 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: localizes M1777 outcome dominance without new rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout localization only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if localization cannot identify dominant outcome slices
stop if ranking blockers are diffuse across roles and profiles
stop if workflow cadence requires branch synthesis
fallback_plan: route to result audit if localization is coherent
route to metric-specific repair design if one role or metric dominates failures
route to branch synthesis if outcomes remain diffuse

admission_evidence: M1778 finds M1777 execution pass but ranking blocked by outcome distribution
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1779 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit, repair, ranking design, or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: dominant slices are identified or explicitly absent

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; localization audits outcomes and does not prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Localization must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcomes are dominated or diffuse, record that as scenario-quality/ranking evidence, not self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1777 outcome dominance can be localized from existing artifacts before ranking or repair.
failure_criteria: localization ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence
dominant slices or next route are ambiguous

commands.name: localize
commands.command: localize bounded-panel outcome dominance from M1777 episode rows without rollout

decision_rule: M1779 passes if it localizes M1777 outcome dominance from existing artifacts and keeps ranking blocked or explicitly admitted by audit criteria.
